start_entries_heading: Received a rent increase? Here is what to do
start_range_text: Find the row in the Mietspiegel, tick the features of your flat.
start_check_text: By when do you have to reply? Is the increase too high?
start_letter_text: Letter in German, explanations in your language.
start_mpb_text: Was the rent already too high when you moved in?
merkmale_rules_summary: Official rules of the Orientierungshilfe (No. 10 of the Mietspiegel)
abschlag_intro: Fixed deduction for older flats that the landlord rents out without a Sammelheizung, without a bathroom (Bad) or without both; the toilet must be inside the flat. Sammelheizung (No. 6.3): heat from one central point, including a heating system for one floor or one flat (Etagenheizung or Wohnungsheizung: gas, oil, electric) that heats all living rooms adequately. Bad: a separate room in the flat with a bathtub or shower and hot water. The official text:
calc_year_intro: Enter the day the rent increase letter arrived (for the rent brake, Mietpreisbremse: the start of the tenancy); the site then chooses the Mietspiegel. Or choose the year yourself.
calc_date_hint: Leave empty if you choose the year yourself.
calc_year_auto: For this date the site uses the Mietspiegel {year}.
calc_year_none: There is no Mietspiegel here for this date (only 2024 and 2026).
calc_wohnlage_help: The Wohnlage depends on the exact address. It is listed in the street directory of the Mietspiegel and in the online lookup of the State of Berlin; the map in the Mietspiegel is only rough.
calc_wohnlage_link: Look up the Wohnlage for your address
calc_baualter_label: Building age (year the building was ready for occupancy)
calc_baualter_hint: A modernised flat usually keeps its year of construction; exceptions exist, e.g. for reconstruction or attic conversions. 1973 to 1990: it matters whether the building is in former East or West Berlin; West-Staaken (today part of Spandau) counts as East. Wendewohnungen (financed with GDR funds, construction started before 3 October 1990, completed only afterwards) belong to ‘1973 bis 1990 Ost’, not to ‘1991 bis 2001’.
calc_area_hint: What counts is the real size, not the number in the tenancy agreement (BGH, judgment of 18.11.2015, VIII ZR 266/14). If the number in the agreement is too large, get advice.
calc_minder_label: The landlord did not provide a Sammelheizung, a bathroom (Bad), or either; the toilet is inside the flat. Deduction: {eur} per m². Sammelheizung (Mietspiegel No. 6.3): heat from one central point, including a heating system for one floor or one flat (Etagenheizung or Wohnungsheizung: gas, oil, electric) that heats all living rooms adequately. Bad: a separate room in the flat with a bathtub or shower and hot water (e.g. an instantaneous water heater, a boiler, a central system).
calc_row_incomplete: Please choose the Wohnlage and building age and enter the living space.
calc_row_none: The Mietspiegel has no value for these details.
calc_row_none_hint: Some combinations do not occur in the Mietspiegel. Check Wohnlage, building age and living space.
calc_row_per_sqm_note: Net cold rent in euros per m² per month. With normal amenities the comparative rent is usually around the average value; the features move it up or down.
calc_features_intro: Tick what exists in the flat, the building and the surroundings.
calc_self_title: Only what the landlord provided counts
calc_self_text: This also applies to Sammelheizung, bathroom and toilet (Mietspiegel No. 6.3). If a tenant installed something themselves and the landlord did not pay back the costs: tick “installed and paid for by me”. If something is only there because you provided it yourself (e.g. a sink or cooker), tick the minus feature for its absence.
calc_compare_label: Compare with the features the landlord ticked
calc_compare_hint: A column “Landlord” then appears, and the result shows where you disagree.
calc_self_installed: installed and paid for by me (does not count)
calc_not_for_baualter: Does not apply to the chosen building age.
calc_exclusive_blocked: Not possible: another feature in this energy group is already ticked.
calc_energy_summary: Enter the value from the energy certificate
calc_energy_intro: With the value from the energy certificate (Energieausweis), the site ticks the energy boxes according to the rules of the Mietspiegel. Use the final energy value (Endenergie: consumption or demand), not the primary energy value (Primärenergie) on the same sheet: it is usually higher with gas or oil and often lower with district heating (Fernwärme).
calc_energy_value: Final energy value (Endenergie) in kWh/(m²·a) (not primary energy, Primärenergie)
calc_energy_bedarf: The value is a demand (Bedarfsausweis), not consumption. Then the limits are 20 % higher.
calc_energy_water: Hot water is produced inside the flat (e.g. with an instantaneous water heater): plus 20 kWh/(m²·a) under the official rule for your Mietspiegel year:
calc_energy_water_excl: The value in the certificate does not include hot water (possible if it is produced inside the flat, e.g. with an instantaneous water heater, and the certificate has no line ‘Warmwasserzuschlag’, hot-water surcharge). Only then are 20 kWh/(m²·a) added, under the official rule for your Mietspiegel year:
calc_energy_invalid: Please enter a number greater than 0.
calc_energy_done: {n} energy boxes ticked. Check the result below.
calc_result_wait: The result appears as soon as the row is found.
calc_result_title: Local comparative rent based on your details
calc_result_monthly: For {area} m² this is per month (net cold rent):
calc_line_span_up: Distance from average to upper value
calc_line_span_down: Distance from average to lower value
calc_line_delta: Surcharge or deduction: sum {net} × one fifth (20 %) of the distance
calc_conflict_mine: Two variants of the energy features are ticked; only one is allowed.
calc_conflict_landlord: The landlord ticked both variants of the energy features.
calc_conflict_landlord_text: Mietspiegel No. 10.4: tick either “insulation or heating system” or the energy value features, not both.
calc_abschlag_note: According to the Mietspiegel, the deduction for substandard amenities (Minderausstattung) is not part of its qualified section (No. 9.4).
calc_oh_note: According to the Mietspiegel, the Orientierungshilfe is a recommended estimation aid that a court can use as the basis for its estimate; it is not part of the qualified Mietspiegel (No. 4 and 10). The list of features is incomplete; in individual cases other important features can count (No. 10.1). So the result is an estimate.
calc_disp_title: Here you disagree with the landlord
calc_disp_plus: Plus features the landlord claims but you do not see
calc_disp_minus: Minus features that exist but the landlord left out
calc_disp_other: There are also {n} more differences in your favour (the landlord lists more minus or fewer plus features).
calc_disp_none: Your details and the landlord’s are the same.

calc_demand_hint: It is in the rent increase letter.
calc_demand_over: The rent demanded is {diff} per month above your result.
calc_demand_within: The rent demanded is not above your result.
calc_demand_implausible: Less than €1 per m²: please check the rent demanded and the living space.

calc_demand_cap_hint: You check the cap (Kappungsgrenze) and the deadlines in the next step.

chk_in_received_hint: Not the date on the letter.
chk_in_demanded_rent: New rent according to the letter (€ per month)
chk_in_demanded_rent_hint: Net cold rent the landlord demands.
chk_in_current_rent_hint: Net cold rent you pay now.
chk_in_area_hint: Needed for the comparative rent per month.
chk_in_last_change: Since when has your current rent applied?
chk_in_last_change_hint: Date of the last rent increase; increases for modernisation or service charges (§§ 559 to 560 BGB) do not count. If there has been none yet: start of the tenancy.
chk_in_last_change_is_start: There has been no rent increase yet; the date is the start of the tenancy.
chk_in_rent_3y_ago: Rent three years before the day the new rent is to apply (€ per month)
chk_in_rent_3y_ago_hint: Unchanged since then: leave the field empty. Tenancy started later: the rent when you moved in.
chk_in_increases_559_560: Increases after modernisation (§ 559 BGB) in these three years (€ per month)
chk_in_increases_559_560_hint: Only increases of the cold rent, not of your advance payments for service charges or heating. If your rent includes a flat rate for service charges, increases of that flat rate count too.
chk_in_requested_effective: From when should the new rent apply according to the letter?
chk_take_from_calc: Use the value from the calculator: {value} (Mietspiegel {year})
chk_need_received: Please first enter when the letter reached you.
chk_find_sperrfrist_fail: Less than one year since the last increase (fixed calculation rule, your details): according to case law, the demand is invalid.
chk_find_sperrfrist_from_start: Less than one year since the start of the tenancy (fixed calculation rule, your details). The Federal Court of Justice (Bundesgerichtshof) has not expressly decided whether the demand is then too early.
chk_find_wartefrist_postponed: The new rent can only apply later.
chk_find_over_cap: The rent demanded is above the cap (Kappungsgrenze).
chk_find_over_ovm: The rent demanded is above the local comparative rent based on your details.
chk_find_within_limits: Based on your details, no limit checked is exceeded.
chk_find_no_ovm: The comparative rent is missing; whether the rent is above it has not been checked.
chk_find_requested_too_early: The landlord names a date that is too early for the new rent.

chk_out_sue_deadline: Deadline for the landlord to sue
chk_out_sperrfrist_earliest_received: Earliest date for a new demand (Sperrfrist)
chk_out_wartefrist_earliest_effective: Earliest date for a new rent (Wartefrist)
chk_out_max_rent: Calculated upper limit under the law and your details
chk_max_rent_lwu_lower: Under the voluntary commitments of the state-owned companies, the limit is lower: {lwu_cap}.
chk_effective_postponed: Without the waiting period it would be {regular}.
chk_wartefrist_postpones: Not complied with. The new rent only applies from this date.
chk_calc_year_mismatch: Your calculator result uses the Mietspiegel {calc}; for this letter {need} applies. Recalculate with {need} in the calculator.
chk_cap_formula: {base} × (1 + {rate}) + {inc} (increases for modernisation or a flat-rate service charge)
chk_over_by: The rent demanded is {over} per month above it.
chk_partial_title: Rent demanded above the calculated upper limit, or letter possibly too early
chk_partial_text: Consent, even partial consent, is binding. Get advice before you reply and read the notes on the reply letter.
letter_step_explain: When does this letter fit? What to watch out for?
letter_warn_consent: With your consent the new rent counts as agreed and you owe it (§ 558b Abs. 1 BGB), even if the increase was not actually allowed.
letter_warn_partial: With a partial consent you owe the rent up to that amount; the landlord can sue for consent to the rest (§ 558b BGB). Afterwards, pay only the amount you consented to.
letter_deadline: Based on your details, your deadline for consent ends on {date}.
letter_features_from_calc: Preselected from your comparison in the calculator (Mietspiegel {year}). You can change the selection.
letter_text_intro: You can edit the text here, but the changes are not saved: if you then change something above or reload the page, the text is created again. So copy, save or print it right away.
letter_missing: {n} details are still missing. They are marked ______ in the letter.
letter_send_text:
Read the whole letter and sign it.

Send it in a way that lets you prove it arrived, for example by registered mail with proof of delivery (Einwurf-Einschreiben) or with a witness who sees it being put in the letterbox. Keep a copy.
letter_field_landlord_name: Name of the landlord or property management
letter_field_demand_date: Date on the rent increase letter
scope_step: Does this check fit your letter?
scope_intro: This check only applies to increases up to the local comparative rent (§ 558 BGB).
scope_ask: Does the letter ask you to consent to the increase?
scope_ask_hint: Typical German words: „Zustimmung“, „Mieterhöhungsverlangen“, „§ 558 BGB“, „ortsübliche Vergleichsmiete“, „Mietspiegel“. Also answer “Yes” if the landlord only writes that they are raising the rent under § 558 BGB or to the local comparative rent (ortsübliche Vergleichsmiete): even then they need your consent.
scope_items_legend: Does any of this apply? Tick everything that fits.
scope_item_sozial: Old social housing flat with „Kostenmiete“ (cost rent): the letter contains words like „Kostenmiete“, „Wirtschaftlichkeitsberechnung“ or „Wohnungsbindungsgesetz“. Do not tick this if you only have a housing entitlement certificate (Wohnberechtigungsschein, WBS).
scope_item_gefoerdert: Newer social housing or another subsidised flat without „Kostenmiete“ (cost rent) (the maximum rent is set by the subsidy)
scope_item_mod559: Increase because of a modernisation (§ 559 BGB)
scope_item_bk560: It is about service or heating charges, for example new advance payments (§ 560 BGB)
scope_item_index_staffel: Your contract has an index or graduated rent (§§ 557a, 557b BGB)
scope_item_s549: Room furnished by the landlord in the landlord’s own flat (unless you live there permanently with your family or partner), flat let only for temporary use (an end date in the contract alone is not enough), or room in a student or youth residence (Studenten- oder Jugendwohnheim) (§ 549 BGB)
scope_item_efh: Flat in a one- or two-family house or a terraced house
scope_item_neubau: Flat only ready for occupancy (bezugsfertig) after the period of the Mietspiegel, e.g. a new build, loft conversion, extension or conversion of commercial premises (Mietspiegel 2026: from 2025, Mietspiegel 2024: from 2023)
scope_item_wc_out: The toilet is outside the flat
scope_not558_title: This check does not fit your letter
scope_not558_text:
– Modernisation, service charges, index or graduated rent, Kostenmiete (cost rent): you usually owe the higher rent even without consent.
– Room furnished by the landlord, flat for temporary use, student or youth residence: the rules on rent increases do not apply; your contract decides. The landlord can give notice more easily there.
– None of these? Show the letter to an advice centre. An increase up to the local comparative rent (§ 558 BGB) needs your consent.

Do not simply stop paying, or you will build up rent arrears. Get advice right away.
scope_notms_title: The Berlin Mietspiegel does not apply to this flat
scope_notms_text: The Mietspiegel only applies to flats that are not price-bound (nicht preisgebunden, i.e. no fixed subsidised rent), with the toilet inside the flat, in buildings with at least three flats, completed within the period of the Mietspiegel (Mietspiegel No. 3 and 6.1). So the calculator cannot work out your comparative rent; get advice. Subsidised flat without Kostenmiete: the landlord still needs your consent, and the rent must not exceed the maximum rent set by the subsidy.
scope_unsure_text: The results only apply to a demand under § 558 BGB that asks for your consent. If in doubt, show the letter to an advice centre before you reply or stop paying.
scope_unanswered: Please first answer the question in step 1.
scope_results_hidden: There is no result here for your case (see the note above).
calc_scope_intro: The Berlin Mietspiegel only applies to flats that are not price-bound (nicht preisgebunden) in buildings with at least three flats (Mietspiegel No. 3 and 6.1).
calc_year_newer: Note: the Mietspiegel {newer} is based on rents as of {stichtag}; your date is after that but before it applied. A court may therefore also use the Mietspiegel {newer}. Calculate with both years and get advice.
calc_baualter_new: Ready for occupancy (bezugsfertig) in {year} or later, including through a loft conversion or extension? Then the {ms} does not apply.
calc_condition_check: The calculator cannot apply this condition; check it yourself:

calc_rounding_note: The Mietspiegel does not say whether to round per group or once at the end. Here it is rounded once; the difference is at most 2 cents per m².
chk_in_lwu: My landlord is a state-owned housing company
chk_lwu_outside_term: The cooperation agreement (Kooperationsvereinbarung) applies from {from} to {to}; your letter arrived outside this period. So we do not check the commitments of the state-owned companies.
chk_rent_3y_date: This means your net cold rent on {date}.
chk_cap_assumed: Here {base} was assumed to be your rent on {date}.
chk_pay_from_later: The landlord names a later date; you only have to pay the new rent from {date}.
chk_find_need_rent_3y: The cap may have been calculated too high
chk_find_over_lwu: The rent demanded is above the commitments of the state-owned companies
chk_find_no_last_change: The blocking period and the waiting period have not been checked
letter_findings_title: Warning: the check found a problem
letter_findings_text: A consent, even a partial one, is still binding. Be sure to get advice first.
letter_no_check_title: You have not checked deadlines and limits yet
letter_incomplete_title: Your check is not complete yet
letter_no_check_text: Before consenting, check whether the letter came too early and whether the rent is above the limits.
letter_binding_text:
As a rule you cannot withdraw a consent.

Tenancy agreement concluded on or after 01.06.2015? First check whether the rent was already too high when you moved in: after a consent you can, as a rule, no longer rely on the rent brake (Mietpreisbremse) against the new rent (BGH, judgment of 28.09.2022, VIII ZR 300/21).

Do not put conditions into the consent („nur wenn …“, “only if …”), and do not sign a form from the landlord that you do not fully understand.
letter_problem_agreed_not_between: The amount does not fit: it must be higher than your current rent and lower than the rent demanded.
letter_problem_agreed_over_max: The amount is above the upper limit calculated from your details ({max}); if you consent, you are bound by it.
letter_problem_agreed_over_lwu: The amount is above the commitments of the state-owned companies ({lwu_cap}); if you consent, you are bound by it.
letter_problem_new_over_demanded: The amount does not fit: the new rent must be higher than your current rent and must not exceed the rent demanded.
chk_year_contested: Your letter arrived after the rents for the Mietspiegel {newer} were surveyed but before it applied. A court may therefore also use the Mietspiegel {newer}. Calculate with {year} and with {newer} in the calculator and get advice.
chk_consent_193: Under the wording of § 193 BGB, the end of the deadline (Saturday, Sunday or public holiday) moves to the next working day, {date}. Whether this applies here is not settled; so reply by the date shown above.
chk_shifted_193: By calculation the deadline ends on {date}, a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, so it moves to the next working day (§ 193 BGB).
chk_invalid_number: We cannot read this number. Write for example 1234.56 or 1234 (no thousands comma).
calc_minder_outside_label: The landlord did not provide a Sammelheizung, a bathroom (Bad), or either.
calc_minder_outside: Without Sammelheizung or without a bathroom, the Mietspiegel gives no value for this building age; the tables only apply to fully equipped flats (No. 9). Get advice.
